program:
PARAMS = {
    "ws":    (6.0, 2.0, 15.0),   # starving NMOS width [um]
    "ls":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),   # starving / reference L (N and P) [um]
    "wn":    (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),    # ring inverter NMOS width (L=0.15)
    "wp":    (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # ring inverter PMOS width (L=0.15)
    "wpref": (5.0, 1.5, 15.0),   # reference PMOS diode width [um]
    "mrat":  (5.0, 2.0, 10.0),   # ring-current / reference-current mirror ratio
    "div":   (0.85, 0.75, 0.97), # vg = div * vctrl
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 3
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    ws, ls, wn, wp = p["ws"], p["ls"], p["wn"], p["wp"]
    M = p["mrat"]; wpref = p["wpref"]; a = p["div"]
    wnref = max(0.42, ws / M)
    wsp = wpref * M

    Rt = 200e3
    R1 = max(1.0, Rt * (1.0 - a))
    R2 = Rt * a

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # control divider -> starving NMOS gate
    n.R("RD1", "vctrl", "vg", R1)
    n.R("RD2", "vg", "vss", R2)
    # reference branch: NMOS (gate vg) -> PMOS diode pb
    n.M("MNREF", "pb", "vg", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wnref, ls)
    n.M("MPREF", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wpref, ls)
    # 3-stage current-starved ring; vout is ring node x0
    nodes = ["vout", "x1", "x2"]
    for i in range(N):
        a_in = nodes[i]; a_out = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.M(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wsp, ls)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", a_out, a_in, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", wp, 0.15)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", a_out, a_in, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", wn, 0.15)
        n.M(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "vg", "vss", "vss", "nfet", ws, ls)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    def idn(vg):
        try:
            return abs(lut.op("n", ws, ls, vg, 0.3)["Id"])
        except Exception:
            return 0.0
    try:
        cn = abs(lut.op("n", wn, 0.15, 0.9, 0.9).get("cgg", 0.0))
        cp = abs(lut.op("p", wp, 0.15, 0.9, 0.9).get("cgg", 0.0))
    except Exception:
        cn = cp = 0.0
    if cn + cp <= 0:
        cn, cp = wn * 1.6e-15, wp * 1.6e-15
    c_node = 1.5 * (cn + cp)               # next gate + drain junction/overlap
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    csum = N * c_node + CL

    def freq(vc):
        I = idn(a * vc)
        f = I / (csum * VDD)
        f_inv_lim = 6e9                      # unstarved inverter-limited ceiling
        return 1.0 / (1.0 / max(f, 1.0) + 1.0 / f_inv_lim)

    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = freq(vlo), freq(vmid), freq(vhi)
    I_mid = idn(a * vmid)
    p_mid = VDD * (I_mid * (1.0 + 1.0 / M) * 1.1) + VDD * vmid / Rt * 0  # divider fed by vctrl, not vdd
    preds = {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
        "swing": 1.65,
        "power": p_mid,
    }
    return n, preds

events.topology: 3-stage current-starved ring, divided-vctrl NMOS starving + PMOS mirror, vout = ring node

events.reason: Ring stalls at vctrl=0.7 V (vg≈0.595 V, deep subthreshold, ~30 MHz) so swing/f_lo fail. Raise divider ratio to lift low-end current 3-5x (f_lo ~150 MHz) keeping ratio >29; f_mid, power have margin.
